seo.description: Get rid of an old mattress in Mobile, AL without hauling it yourself. Zoiris picks up mattresses, box springs, and bed frames straight from the bedroom.
seo.ogTitle: Mattress Removal in Mobile, AL — Zoiris Junk Removal
seo.ogDescription: Mattresses, box springs, and bed frames carried out of the bedroom and hauled away in Mobile, Alabama.

purpose: Serve people in Mobile who need an old mattress, box spring, or bed frame gone — often right after a new mattress arrives — and want it carried out of the bedroom instead of dragged to the curb.

content.lead: Zoiris Junk Removal picks up old mattresses, box springs, and bed frames from homes and rentals in Mobile, Alabama. We take them straight from the bedroom — no wrestling a floppy queen down the stairs, no strapping it to a car roof, and no mattress leaning against the house for a week.

quickAnswer.question: What's the easiest way to get rid of an old mattress in Mobile?
quickAnswer.answer: Have it picked up from the room it's in. Tell us the size and how many pieces are going — mattress, box spring, frame, headboard — and we confirm an estimate and a pickup window. Our crew carries everything out and hauls it away.

includes.heading: What mattress removal includes
includes.intro: A mattress pickup covers the whole bed setup, not just the top layer.
points: Lifting the mattress off the bed and carrying it out of the bedroom, including from upstairs rooms.
Box springs, foundations, and bunkie boards.
Taking apart metal or wood bed frames, bunk beds, daybeds, and attached headboards so they fit through doorways.
Several mattresses in one visit — a guest room, kids' bunk beds, or a rental unit's worth.

items.heading: Bedroom items we remove
items.intro: Every size from crib to California king:
list: Innerspring, memory foam, hybrid, and pillow-top mattresses
Box springs, split foundations, and bunkie boards
Metal frames, wood bed frames, bunk beds, daybeds, and trundles
Adjustable or power bed bases — call to confirm

audience.heading: Who calls for mattress pickup
body: Most calls come after a new mattress has been delivered and the old one has nowhere to go, or when a bed-in-a-box replaced a full mattress set. Parents call when kids move from bunk beds to full-size beds, and people downsizing often need guest room beds cleared.

Landlords and short-term rental hosts use the same service when they replace mattresses between guests or tenants. If the whole unit needs clearing, see [apartment cleanouts](/services/apartment-cleanouts/).

steps.title: Count the pieces
steps.body: Let us know the mattress size, how many mattresses and box springs there are, and whether the frame and headboard are going too. Send it by phone or [pickup request](/request-pickup/).

steps.title: Lock in the details
steps.body: We confirm an estimate and a pickup window. If there's a bed bug concern or a power base involved, we talk it through at this step.

steps.title: Off the bed and out the door
steps.body: The crew breaks down the frame, carries each piece out, and takes care around railings and door frames on the way.

pricingFactors.heading: What affects mattress removal cost
pricingFactors.intro: There's no flat rate — the estimate reflects what's actually being removed:
factors: How many pieces: a mattress alone versus a full set with box spring, frame, and headboard
Size and weight — a king pillow-top is much heavier than a twin foam mattress
Frame disassembly, especially bunk beds and storage beds
Stairs, tight landings, or a long carry to the truck
Mattresses that need special handling, such as ones with bed bugs or water damage

prepare.heading: Before we arrive
tips: Strip the sheets, mattress protector, and pillows, and keep any bedding you want to reuse.
If a new mattress is on the way, book the pickup for after it's delivered so nobody spends a night on the floor.
Check under the bed and between the mattress and box spring — phones, jewelry, and documents turn up there.
If bed bugs are a concern, tell us first. Sealing the mattress in a plastic mattress bag helps contain them during the carry-out.
For an adjustable base, lower it flat and unplug it before pickup day.

restrictions.heading: Mattresses that need a heads-up
restrictions.body: These are still possible in many cases, but we need to know before scheduling:
list: Mattresses with known bed bugs or other pests — tell us in advance so handling can be planned
Mattresses soaked by flooding, leaks, or other water damage
Adjustable and power bases, which are heavy and have motors — describe the model when you call
Waterbed mattresses must be completely drained before pickup

faqs.q: Do you take the box spring and bed frame too?
faqs.a: Yes. Box springs, foundations, frames, and headboards are all part of mattress removal. The crew takes the frame apart if it won't fit through the door assembled.

faqs.q: Will you take a mattress with bed bugs?
faqs.a: Tell us before you book. We need to know in advance so we can plan how it's handled, and we'll explain any preparation needed, such as bagging the mattress.

faqs.q: Can't I just put the mattress at the curb?
faqs.a: City of Mobile residents may be able to set bedding out for the city's residential trash collection, following the city's schedule and rules — check with [City of Mobile Public Works](https://www.cityofmobile.gov). A pickup from us makes sense when you'd rather not haul it outside yourself, have other items going too, or don't want it sitting at the curb.

faqs.q: Do you take adjustable bed bases?
faqs.a: Adjustable and power bases are call to confirm. They're heavy and have motors, so describe the brand or model and where the bed is located when you contact us.

faqs.q: Will my old mattress be recycled?
faqs.a: Where practical options exist, mattress materials are separated from items going to disposal. We can't promise a specific outcome for every mattress — ask us if you want to know what's likely for yours.

content.areaNote: Mattress removal is available at homes and rental properties throughout the City of Mobile. If you're outside the city, call to confirm before booking.
